seoTitle: Which Parks and Rec Character Are You? Parks and Recreation Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Parks and Rec test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Leslie, Ron, April, Andy, Tom, Ben, Ann or Donna — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the endlessly optimistic go-getter, the steak-loving loner who hates fuss, or the one who's here to treat yo' self? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle work, friends and free time and find out which Parks and Rec character you are.

characters.name: Leslie Knope
characters.title: The Unstoppable Optimist
characters.summary: Passionate, hardworking and relentlessly positive. You have a binder for everything and a plan to make the world better.
description: Like Leslie, you care deeply — about your town, your work and especially your friends. She'll give her best friend a 5,000-word essay on why she's awesome.
You work harder than anyone. Binders, reports, and 3am brainstorms are your idea of a good time.
You love a celebration, and you invented a few of your own. Galentine's Day, anyone? Waffles are involved.
characters.flaw: You're so intense that you can steamroll people without realising.
characters.signature: A stack of binders, a plate of waffles and a very long list of ideas.
characters.clashReason: they'd make you go to every meeting — with a binder

characters.name: Ron Swanson
characters.title: The Stoic Individualist
characters.summary: Private, self-reliant and deeply suspicious of everything. You love meat, silence and working with your hands.
description: Like Ron, you value your privacy above almost everything. He's the head of a government department who thinks government should barely exist.
You like simple things done well. Steak, breakfast food, whisky and woodworking.
You've got secrets — Ron is secretly the smooth jazz saxophonist Duke Silver — and you're a lot softer about your friends than you'd ever admit.
characters.flaw: You shut people out and refuse to change your mind.
characters.signature: A steak, a glass of whisky and a hand-built chair.
characters.clashReason: they'd think everything you care about is a waste of money

characters.name: April Ludgate
characters.title: The Deadpan Weirdo
characters.summary: Sarcastic, dark and gloriously unbothered. You pretend you hate everything — except the few people you'd do anything for.
description: Like April, you're allergic to enthusiasm. You'd rather be anywhere else, doing anything else, with nobody watching.
You're weird on purpose, and you love it. April finds the dark side of everything funny.
But you've got a big heart hidden very deep down, and your love for your people is fierce.
characters.flaw: You push people away with sarcasm and pretend not to care.
characters.signature: A black outfit, a blank stare and a very dry one-liner.
characters.clashReason: they'd find everything you love boring

characters.name: Andy Dwyer
characters.title: The Lovable Goofball
characters.summary: Fun, sweet and delightfully clueless. You see the world like a big kid — and people love you for it.
description: Like Andy, you're pure joy. Every day is an adventure, and every idea is the best idea you've ever had.
You're a musician at heart. Andy fronts the band Mouse Rat, and he's had more band names than anyone can remember.
You might not always think things through, but you've got the biggest heart in Pawnee.
characters.flaw: You don't think things through, and you get distracted very easily.
characters.signature: A guitar, a band name and a huge grin.

characters.name: Tom Haverford
characters.title: The Hustling Entrepreneur
characters.summary: Flashy, ambitious and full of business ideas. You're always one big idea away from making it.
description: Like Tom, you've got swag and you've got plans. He's pitched more business ideas than anyone in Pawnee — and some even worked.
You love the finer things. Nice clothes, gadgets and an annual Treat Yo' Self day with your best friend.
Behind the hustle, you want people to take you seriously — and eventually, they do.
characters.flaw: You overspend, overpromise and chase the next shiny thing.
characters.signature: A tailored suit, a new app idea and a big "Treat yo' self!"
characters.clashReason: they'd spend money on everything, all the time

characters.name: Ben Wyatt
characters.title: The Lovable Nerd
characters.summary: Smart, responsible and a proud nerd. You love budgets, board games and calzones — and you're a great partner.
description: Like Ben, you're the responsible one. He came to Pawnee to fix the budget, and he actually knows what he's doing with numbers.
You're a proud nerd. Ben invented a famously complicated board game, the Cones of Dunshire, during a break between jobs.
You're supportive and steady, and you're happiest helping the people you love reach their dreams.
characters.flaw: You overthink things, and you get very grumpy when stressed.
characters.signature: A calzone, a spreadsheet and a very complicated board game.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you to stick to the budget

characters.name: Ann Perkins
characters.title: The Grounded Best Friend
characters.summary: Kind, level-headed and the most supportive friend imaginable. You keep your people grounded — and you're still figuring out yourself.
description: Like Ann, you're the reasonable one. She's a nurse who keeps her head in a town full of chaos.
You're an incredible friend. Ann is Leslie's best friend and receives a steady stream of wildly specific compliments.
You're still working out what you want, and you try on a few different versions of yourself along the way.
characters.flaw: You lose yourself in other people's plans and relationships.
characters.signature: Scrubs, a calm voice and a best friend who calls you a beautiful tropical fish.
characters.clashReason: they'd be too sensible for your plans

characters.name: Donna Meagle
characters.title: The Confident Queen
characters.summary: Confident, stylish and completely unbothered. You know your worth, and you treat yo' self accordingly.
description: Like Donna, you're confident without trying. You know exactly who you are and you don't explain yourself.
You love the good life — your car, your style, your Treat Yo' Self day. Donna even has a famous cousin: the singer Ginuwine.
You keep your personal life private, but your friends know you've always got their back.
characters.flaw: You can be a little too unbothered when people need you to care.
characters.signature: A Mercedes, sunglasses and zero apologies.
characters.clashReason: they'd do whatever they want and not care what you think

questions.text: Your workplace announces a mandatory team-building day. You...

options.text: Volunteer to organise it. You already have 40 ideas
Develop a sudden illness that lasts exactly one day
Go, and make it as awkward as possible for everyone
So excited. Is there going to be a bouncy castle?

questions.text: You get an unexpected bonus at work. You...

options.text: Spend it today on something shiny and unnecessary
Invest it. You've got a good feeling about property
Straight into savings. Obviously
Keep it somewhere the government can't touch it

questions.text: A friend asks for help with a big project at the last minute. You...

options.text: Yes! And you'll make them a binder
Of course — and you'll keep them calm while you do it
Sure! Wait, what's the project?
Say no. Then show up anyway

questions.text: You're handed a huge stack of forms to fill in. You...

options.text: Put them off as long as humanly possible
Get quietly excited. You love this kind of thing
Pass them to someone else — delegation is a skill
Fill them in carefully, then help everyone else with theirs

questions.text: You've had a terrible day. What fixes it?

options.text: A steak and total silence
Buying yourself something nice
Talking it through with your best friend
A nap and some cartoons
Jam in the garage with friends, very loudly
Horror movies, in bed, all day
Pitch a new business idea to anyone who'll listen
Board games with friends. You'll bring the rulebook

questions.text: Someone you love tells you about a huge dream. You...

options.text: Drop everything to help them get there
Tell everyone you know how amazing they are. Loudly
Help them work out if it's what they really want
Support them quietly, without making a big deal of it

questions.text: A friend asks your honest opinion on their terrible idea. You...

options.text: Tell them it's terrible. Brutally
Be honest — then say what you'd do instead
Love it! Wait, why is it terrible?
Pitch them a better idea you've been sitting on

questions.text: Your friend signs you both up for a charity 5K. You...

options.text: Make it a whole event, with matching T-shirts
Hand over a donation and skip the running
Download an app and track every statistic
Walk it. Slowly. Complaining the whole way

questions.text: A local community meeting turns into a shouting match. You...

options.text: Stand up and give an impassioned speech
Try to explain the budget. Nobody listens
Leave. You're not paid enough for this
Sit at the back and enjoy the chaos

questions.text: You work for your town, and there's money for one project: a park the kids really need, or fixing the roads everyone complains about. You...

options.text: The park. It'll change lives
The one that pushes up property prices
Neither. Give the money back to the taxpayers
Whichever one gets you on the local news

questions.text: Your best friend is running for local office. What's your role on the campaign?

options.text: Campaign manager. You know how to run this
By their side the whole way, keeping them sane
Branding, social media and a very good logo
Helping — while pretending you don't care
